pages.text: One fruit was ripening at the very top of a tree. It was too high for anyone to pick. Taro and Mumu looked up.
"It'll be just ripe tomorrow." "Let's eat it together tomorrow!" They hooked their little fingers.
The next morning, they ran to the tree. The fruit was gone!
Taro looked up. Nothing was on the branch. "Did you come here first?"
"No, I just got here." Mumu looked up, too. "Then you didn't see it either?"
"I just got here, too." They checked every branch. It really was nowhere to be found.
They rustled through the grass. Who could have taken it?
Something squished under Mumu's foot. The fruit had fallen into the grass and burst open. Ants covered it in long lines.
Just then, plop! Another fruit fell by itself from the next tree. "Oh, ripe fruit falls down! Let's spread leaves here."
The next day, three fruits lay on their bed of leaves. Both looked up, wondering whether another would fall.
